description:
According to Alfred Bielek, "In the 1940s, a secret mind control project began at Brookhaven National Laboratories. The official goal: influence human behavior.

But what they found wasn't in any textbook.

Because the human mind didn't just respond to technology. It interacted with reality itself. And once they learned to create matter from nothing... they started asking more dangerous questions.

Then things went further than anyone expected.

They reached a point where there was no turning back. What began as control over the mind became something else entirely. Something that blurred the line between what's real and what's possible.

By August 12, 1983, that line was gone.

And once that line was crossed... there was no going back.

What started as mind control led to something they never intended to create."

- Time has been disturbed forever 40 years ago

*Source: Al Bielek, public conferences, interviews, and documented testimony (1990-2010).*
